summary: Comprehensive testing of Bell Canada TV Service Clone new customer features: registration flow, customer login, PIN-based device activation with IP lockout, refresh PIN, My Account dashboard, and admin customer management. All 26 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend flows verified and working correctly via Playwright.

minor.issue: IP-based lockout state persists across test runs (45-min lockout). Future test runs will fail if IP is still locked from previous run. Not a code bug - a testing infra concern. Mitigation: clear pin_attempt_log collection in MongoDB before running backend tests.

action_items: TESTING INFRA NOTE: Before running backend tests for customer PIN activation, ensure pin_attempt_log collection is cleared (IP lockout from previous runs blocks new activation tests). Add MongoDB cleanup step or admin API endpoint to clear lockouts for testing.
critical_code_review_comments: IP LOCKOUT PERSISTENCE: The pin_attempt_log collection persists IP-based lockout state indefinitely (until 45-min window expires). If the same IP (e.g. test container) runs tests repeatedly, activation tests will fail after 3 bad PINs until lockout expires. Consider adding an admin API endpoint to clear lockout records for a specific IP for testing purposes.

QR CODE SERVING: QR code served at ${BACKEND_URL}/api/uploads/qr_codes/{file} - this works correctly because server.py likely mounts the /uploads directory under /api. Verified working in screenshots.
CODE QUALITY: customer.py is 379 lines - within acceptable range. No major DRY violations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All flows verified: /register landing page, registration form with device brand/type/disclaimer, success page with PIN, /customer-login, /my-account redirect when unauthenticated, /my-account with large PIN display + QR code, /activate mode selection (PIN vs code), /activate?pin=XXXXX pre-fill, E2E PIN activation success

IP_Lockout_Test_State.root_cause: The test_lockout_after_three_bad_pins test submits 3 wrong PINs which locks the test container's IP in pin_attempt_log for 45 minutes. On the next test run, test_activate_with_valid_pin fails with 429 because the IP is still locked from the previous run.
IP_Lockout_Test_State.reproduction: 1. Run pytest test_customer_features_iter5.py. 2. All tests pass. 3. Run pytest again immediately. 4. TestPinActivation tests fail with 429 Too Many Failed Attempts.
IP_Lockout_Test_State.mitigation: Add a MongoDB cleanup step before TestPinActivation class (or at module start) that deletes all pin_attempt_log records. This was done manually during testing by running a Python script to clear the collection.
